title: Restore CI quality gates: ffmpeg, Playwright smoke, Python lint, coverage
severityRationale: Regressions in UI, native, and audio paths merge without detection.
impactSpreadRationale: Affects every screen and the entire audio pipeline.
recommendedFix: Collapse the two workflows into one; apt-get install ffmpeg; run a Playwright route smoke subset per PR; add ruff and mypy on changed modules; fail on coverage regression.

title: Add coverage measurement and thresholds
severityRationale: Without a baseline, untested changes look identical to tested ones.
impactSpreadRationale: Applies to all frontend and backend code.
evidence: No coverage configuration or threshold exists in the repo
recommendedFix: Enable vitest v8 coverage with a documented baseline, add pytest-cov for backend, and fail CI when coverage drops.

title: Remove Docker and Compose configuration drift
severityRationale: Container builds and startup are fragile; onboarding via Docker is unreliable.
impactSpreadRationale: Affects backend deployment, local setup, and CI image builds.
recommendedFix: Keep one Dockerfile, copy sources before editable install, remove the unused asyncpg URL or consume it with a declared driver, and build the image in CI.

title: Document configuration and environment variables
severityRationale: Setup friction and misconfiguration, but recoverable.
impactSpreadRationale: Affects every developer and deployment.
recommendedFix: Generate an env reference from code, mark required/optional and defaults, and extend .env.example with backend flags.

title: Triage dependency advisories and apply non-major upgrades
severityRationale: One critical and 18 high advisories, including a direct expo-router finding.
impactSpreadRationale: Touches build, runtime, and web/native delivery.
evidence: npm audit --json: 1 critical, 18 high, 35 moderate, 1 low
recommendedFix: Apply npm audit fix for non-major updates, verify with lint/tests, and track the direct expo-router major fix in the Expo SDK upgrade item.

title: Add Python dependency locking and vulnerability auditing
severityRationale: Non-reproducible installs and unknown Python CVE exposure.
impactSpreadRationale: Affects every backend install and deployment.
evidence: pip-audit is not installed in the WSL environment
recommendedFix: Adopt pip-compile/uv lock, run pip-audit in CI, and move training-only packages (tensorflow-model-optimization) to a training extra.

title: Narrow broad exception handling and stop silent passes
severityRationale: Failures can degrade silently into fallback output or missing metrics.
impactSpreadRationale: Spans analysis, metrics, jobs, and enrichment.
recommendedFix: Catch the narrow exception types actually expected, log with context and job id, emit a counter for each fallback, and replace silent pass with debug logging.

title: Archive dead research snapshots and reduce repository bloat
severityRationale: Clone/CI cost and confusing duplicates, but no runtime impact.
impactSpreadRationale: Developer workflow and repository size.
recommendedFix: Move archived versions and model binaries to release artifacts or Git LFS, delete the unreferenced bak_phase1 directory, and stop tracking backup model files.

title: Move the two out-of-layer API calls behind src/api
severityRationale: Inconsistent auth, retry, and error behavior; moderate maintenance cost.
impactSpreadRationale: Seven files and all API-backed screens.
recommendedFix: Add one src/api helper for /session/orient-clip, use it from both call sites, and add an import-boundary rule that forbids API fetches outside src/api.

title: Resolve or track TODO/@deprecated markers by theme
severityRationale: Placeholder behavior and export deprecations are easy to forget.
impactSpreadRationale: Auth, onboarding, coach, and GP5 export paths.
recommendedFix: Convert each marker to a tracked ticket with an owner or remove it; resolve the GP5 deprecation by naming MusicXML as the only render path.

title: Add deployment automation with migration and image checks
severityRationale: No repeatable production path; releases depend on manual steps.
impactSpreadRationale: Backend, database, and mobile delivery.
evidence: backend/Dockerfile:19 (alembic upgrade head at container start)
recommendedFix: Add image build/publish, a migration dry-run against Postgres, artifact versioning, and one documented production/staging promotion path.

title: Refresh stale documentation and add a docs index
severityRationale: Stale setup claims mislead new developers; no docs index slows onboarding.
impactSpreadRationale: README, setup docs, and onboarding.
evidence: README.md:358 (says MIDI export uses Basic Pitch)
README.md:709 (presents basic-pitch-only pipeline as the gate)
docs/ has 19 Markdown files but no docs/README.md index
AGENTS.md documents MT3 as primary with Basic Pitch as fallback
recommendedFix: Correct line 358 to describe the GP5-to-MIDI exporter, rewrite line 709 for the MT3-primary pipeline with Basic Pitch as fallback, add docs/README.md indexing active guides, and add a last-verified date to setup instructions.

title: Reduce single-maintainer bus factor
severityRationale: One person holds nearly all context; continuity risk is existential.
impactSpreadRationale: Every module, deployment, and research result.
evidence: git shortlog -sne HEAD: 102 + 100 commits by cnkunda
git shortlog -sne --all adds 5 VS Code entries
recommendedFix: Accepted risk: Harmoniq is intentionally single-maintainer. Revisit CODEOWNERS, pair-review, and ownership rotation only if a second maintainer joins.

title: Replace or gate shipped stub and placeholder product flows
severityRationale: Users can see simulated analysis and template-only coaching as real behavior.
impactSpreadRationale: Onboarding, coaching, and home identity.
recommendedFix: Wire onboarding to POST /analyze or label it as a demo; implement or clearly badge the template coach; read the display name from profile or a neutral default.

title: Assign ownership and refactor plans for churn x complexity hotspots
severityRationale: The most-edited, largest files are where defects and merge conflicts concentrate.
impactSpreadRationale: Analysis, jobs, schemas, session, and fretboard UI.
recommendedFix: Accepted risk for ownership/review-budget process in a single-maintainer project. Refactor work is tracked by TD-22 (backend god modules) and TD-23 (frontend god screens); use churn x size to prioritize opportunistic extractions.

title: Decide production job runtime instead of silent thread fallback
severityRationale: Work is lost on restart when Celery is unavailable.
impactSpreadRationale: All analysis and recompute jobs.
recommendedFix: Resolved: staging/production require the Celery worker; HARMONIQ_SKIP_CELERY=1 is local/dev/test only and is surfaced as job_runtime=thread with degraded /health. Restart behavior documented and tested.

title: Unify native and web database implementations
severityRationale: Silent divergence can corrupt or lose user progress across platforms.
impactSpreadRationale: All persistence, sessions, lessons, skills, and jam history.
evidence: ~2,100 non-whitespace diff lines between the clients
AGENTS.md:234-239 (14 mobile migrations vs v4 web versioning)
recommendedFix: Define a shared behavioral contract test suite that runs against both clients, converge migration numbering, and move platform-specific code behind narrow adapters.

title: Add tests for critical untested paths (audio, DB, config, components)
severityRationale: The highest-risk runtime code has no direct unit coverage.
impactSpreadRationale: Audio capture/playback, persistence, and all UI components.
evidence: src/audio/recordSession.* and src/db/client.* have no direct tests
recommendedFix: Add jsdom + Testing Library for component tests, prioritize GlobalAudioManager, recordSession, both DB clients, and config, and set a ratcheting coverage floor.

title: Remove unstripped frontend console logging
severityRationale: Noise and minor information leakage in release builds.
impactSpreadRationale: Many screens and modules.
evidence: 179 console.* calls under src/, app/, and components/
AGENTS.md logging convention (prefixed debug logging only)
recommendedFix: Route logs through a small logger that is disabled in production, and remove per-render logs.

title: Reduce full backend suite runtime and remove duplicate runs
severityRationale: Slow feedback and doubled CI cost.
impactSpreadRationale: Every PR and push.
recommendedFix: Run a fast subset on PRs and the full suite on main/nightly; shard by test file group and cache the heavy model fixtures.

title: Plan the Expo SDK 58 / React Native 0.88 upgrade
severityRationale: Staying on SDK 54 increases security and ecosystem drift over time.
impactSpreadRationale: Entire frontend and native build.
evidence: npm audit: direct expo-router high finding fixed only in 58.0.31
recommendedFix: Run an isolated upgrade spike using the Expo SDK upgrade guide, verify native modules and Detox on a device, and land it without feature changes.

title: Split backend god modules and the 807-line pipeline function
severityRationale: Very high change cost and defect surface in core analysis.
impactSpreadRationale: Analysis, jobs, schemas, and MusicXML generation.
recommendedFix: Extract main.py endpoints into routers, split the lesson builder into ingest/analyze/transcribe/assemble stages with boundary tests, and set a per-function complexity budget.

title: Split frontend god screens into hooks and presentational components
severityRationale: Large stateful screens are hard to review, test, and change safely.
impactSpreadRationale: Jam, study, home, and fretboard flows.
recommendedFix: Extract domain logic into hooks, split render sections into components, add component tests, and adopt a file-size warning threshold.

title: Remove unused @tombatossals/react-chords dependency
severityRationale: Dead dependency adds install and audit surface.
impactSpreadRationale: Single package.
recommendedFix: Remove the package from package.json and regenerate the lockfile after confirming the hand-rolled SVG renderer remains the only path.
